summary: Isabela 3rd District representative with 11 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant items are an anti-dynasty ban, electric-cooperative franchises and co-authored fuel-tax relief. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Few rubric-relevant bills surfaced; the rest of the portfolio was not individually reviewed.
